name: Karazhan’s Master’s Terrace
shortDescription: Karazhan’s Master’s Terrace, a named setting in the Karazhan research story.
body: The associated original environment art preserves these Exposed upper tower terrace with black stone parapets, rain-dark flagstones, stormy violet night and broad height over fogbound Deadwind Pass. It remains an interpretive scene; no exact route, dungeon layout or surveyed coordinate is asserted.
